nom: Neutrogena Evenly Clear Retinoid Adapalene Gel 0.1%

avis.texte: I used it for the amount of time it says to. I understand there is a purging period but it made my skin super dry, red, burn, and made me have under the skin breakouts which I never get

avis.titre: Really easy to use, love retinoids!
avis.texte: Retinoids are amazing & I love now that I can also include fighting acne into the many things they can do for me!! Can't wait to see what they come up with next.
I have always wanted to try a retinoid & I'm glad I started here. Easy on the skin & absolutely delighted with the results! My skin feels softer & clearer already!

Overall, I didn't see much of a difference a difference in my skin after using it consistently for more than 1 weeks. I was still getting acne even though I was applying this retinoid. As a oily skin girl, it isn't for me.
I love how this product works on my skin by clearing it out form acne without giving me a greasy feeling when applying it. It dries out the pimples which is great.

I really enjoyed the product. I haven't seen a big difference yet but so far I noticed nothing different in my acne issues. The cream isn't oily which is great and I did notice it doesn't dry my skin out. I defiantly will keep trying it out and see if I see a better difference.

I found this acne gel to be non-irritating or drying. It slowly dissolved the small pimple i had on my chin away in six days. This did not cause flaking but did cause mild redness. I would recommend this.

I tried this once-daily acne cream and want to share my honest impressions. How I use it: I apply the cream in the evening after washing, to clean, dry skin. The consistency is light and absorbs quickly. The cream has a delicate texture and doesn't leave a sticky film. The scent is almost invisible—a big plus, because I don't like products with a strong or chemical smell. After just a few days, I noticed that my inflamed pimples became less painful and slightly smaller. Smaller ones started to clear up faster. New breakouts are slightly fewer than usual. Pimples are gone!

This is a nice, gentle retinoid that helps clear stubborn acne. Would recommend wearing sunscreen while using this product, just like other retinoids, but overall it is gentle on the skin and effective at clearing acne. Would recommend!
I really enjoyed using this product. It has made my skin look so much better than what it looked like before. It's a must to try, you won't be disappointed.
The Evenly Clear Facial was gentle for my problem areas. It worked well without drying out my skin. I will continue using it as outbreaks occur in the future.

I had a chance to try this evenly clear retinoid by Neutrogena. I do like the formulation and although I only used it for a few days, I did not experience any sensitivity. I genuinely enjoyed using this gently formula that entails adapalence 0.1%. I feel with regular consistency results are achievable. I only gave it four stars due to not using it for a month.

This was an easy straight forward retinol. It's roughly half of prescription strength. There was usual flaking for the first few days but it went away with gradual usage. I liked it and would definitely purchase.

I have used the Neutrogena brand before and loved it and this gave the same results. A thin layer goes along way and it truly gives for clearer smoother skin within 1-2 uses. I use it at night and ensure SPF in the morning, but have been using this around my hormonal breakouts and I rarely break out anymore!
I get significant blackheads on my forehead. While I did notice a decline in clogged pores, it wasn't an improvement significant enough to justify the price of this stuff if I had to buy it myself.

I have used this facial retinoid product for a couple weeks now and I have really enjoyed that it has not caused me any irritation. No major peeling, no redness and dryness happening after i started this product. My face does appear to be a tab bit more smooth and even a couple acne spots that I had, have started to clear up.
I loved this product. It was much more gentle on my skin than other brands that I have tried and a great price point. Neutrogena never fails to put out great products.
Good packaging. Used this product few times at night and applied moisturizer afterwards. there was no scent. Did make skin slightly dry compared to other retinoid. Overall good product .

I've been using this daily for over a week now. So far my skin is feeling smoother and hydrated. I have an issue with dry or dull skin. I see so far a gently glow so I'm excited of what it will be if I continue to use daily for months. Definitely recommend it. It's a high quality formula. No stickiness or residue

avis.titre: I love this stuff so much!
avis.texte: This stuff works so good for me, my kids and my husband. If you suffer from acne, black heads or acne scarring, this stuff helps tremendously! With enough uses, it's lightened my acne scars and made my acne a lot less visible/or made it go away completely. This stuff is super smooth, doesn't leave a residue or sticky feeling and doesn't smell horrible like I've seen in other products.

I get hormonal acne and love having something to use during those breakouts. This cream is perfect! It is super gentle on the skin, no irritation or redness. It has a moisturizing texture and helps my pores unclog.

I was very happy with this product. I've tried many products over the years most with less than optimal results - this definitely did not fit that trend! It applies smoothly, blends in well and actually works to keep my complexion clear of acne (who knew it doesn't go away after teen years), moisturized and even (no red spots or areas you can tell you applied a retinoid). Very happy and would recommend!
This is a really nice product to help with breakouts. I have been having more breakouts in my 40s and this has helped tame them. I use before going to bed and it helps dry out any acne.
My skin is definitely looking more clear and smooth after using this product. The formula is relatively light and it doesn't make my skin look greasy.

I received this product complimentary from Home Tester Club in exchange for my honest opinion and review. I have fairly sensitive skin that is acne prone. Upon receiving this product I had an active breakout on my chin. After a few days of use, I noticed my breakout starting to clear up. After 2 weeks of use I barely have any blemishes on my chin. I definitely recommend this product and could see myself purchasing in future.
This resinous treatment is wonderful. It's not too harsh and worked great. My skin is doing so much better after just a few weeks.

It goes on smooth and works pretty well. It helps with acne but is definitely a very small tube that wasn't made to last. I think putting it in a large box is slightly deceptive. Overall it worked but I wasn't blown away with it.

I really enjoyed using this product. It didn't irritate my skin at all. After using it several times, I noticed an overall more radiant look to my skin. I would definitely recommend this. I received this product for free in exchange for my honest review.

The product feels nice as a moisturizer, but I did feel like it dried my skin out a bit. I didn't notice any changes or improvement from using this product. It seemed to irritate certain areas on my face. I have pretty sensitive skin, so I probably wouldn't recommend for those skin types. Overall didn't see any noticeable difference in using it.

I've been using this every night and I actually really like it. It helps dry out pimples and I've noticed fewer breakouts when I use it consistently. It's lightweight and doesn't feel greasy, which I appreciate. After a while, my skin started looking clearer overall. It's now just part of my regular nighttime routine.
This was not irritating. The cream is very lightweight. I felt like it worked quickly and the size of the pimples reduced fast. I feel that using it over time would help reduce breakouts.

This is an excellent acne treatment for my skin. Since it's a retinoid, it helps with the clearing of your skin, as well as the look. Acne scars are something that I always try to avoid, so this was so helpful. The acne that I had did fade quickly and did not leave any marks on my skin after healing, which is amazing. I do have slightly sensitive skin and it did not irritate my skin at all!
I really enjoyed using this product. It is a great over the counter option for those that don't want prescription strength retinol. It went on easily and made my skin glowy!

avis.titre: One of the best acne treatments
avis.texte: One of the best acne treatments I've tried so far. I get acne randomly throughout the month and it gets annoying. This treatment treats my acne spots. It's a once daily treatment which is nice. Didn't irritate my skin. It's oil and fragrance free.

I tried neutrogena evenly clear retinoid and was quite pleased. The texture is lightweight and absorbs easily without feeling heavy or greasy. I've noticed my skin texture looks smoother and breakouts seem fewer and less intense since I started using it. It's strong enough to be effective but gentle enough that I haven't experienced irritation when I introduce it slowly into my routine. It layers well with moisturizers and doesn't pill under makeup. I would recommend it.
I feel like my skin is noticeably clearer and in better health overall. Redness has decreased and my skin feel nourished and smooth. It's a small tube to a little goes a long way.

I used this product without editing my usual nighttime skin care routine, and it fit in perfectly. I have had stubborn acne for about the past decade now, but in the 2 weeks that I have used and tested this product, I have already seen a difference. Not only does it remove some of my current acne, but I can definitely see some of my scars lightening. I am for sure purchasing my own after I run out of this tester one. 10/10 recommend!
I like how light weight and fast absorbing this formula is, only downside is that it is a bit pricy compared to the size but it is a good quality

I was able to try Evenly Clear facial retinoid cream and I was really pleased with it. I really liked how it absorbed into my skin with no greasy residue and how there wasn't a strong fragrance to endure. I will continue to use and also recommend to family and friends.

I received this product for free from Home tester for my honest opinion, I use a little bit everyday in my face for stubborn acne, so far its good, its not drying my face its gentle and I will give it a try in my skincare routine.

While this reduced some redness of my pimple, it unfortunately did not do much else. I used it multiple days in a row without a lot of improvement. I did like how it was cooling with application and absorbed well into my skin.

I've used it couple of times so far and I've already noticed a small difference in my skin. It looks a bit clearer and smoother, and I'm hopeful that I'll continue to see even more improvement as I keep using it consistently. One thing I really appreciate is that it doesn't irritate my skin. I have sensitive skin and many of the acne or retinol products tend to leave my face feeling dry or uncomfortable. This one has been gentle and hasn't caused any redness or burning after use. So far, I'm happy with the results and look forward to seeing continued progress over time.

I was super excited to try this product as I'm getting to the age where my skin is less youthful than it once was. However, my skin did not agree with this product and I broke out. I had to discontinue using it and I was super bummed! The scent was not overpowering and the overall feel was pleasant.

Worked on minimizing appearance of acne and left face feeling clean. Did not complete remove acne but did a good job. They are less irritated and make face appearance better. I would definitely recommend for other, but everyones skin is different

I've been using that evenly clear facial retinoid and I'm really impressed so far it's super easy to fly and has a nice smooth, clear texture that spreads evenly without feeling heavy or greasy. It absorbs well and doesn't leave my skin feeling sticky, since using it consistently, it's been working great at keeping my acne under control and helping my skin look clear overall. definitely a solid edition to my routine.
This is super effective and high quality. Use to be prescription only so really convenient to get it over the counter from a trusted brand

Used it over a week now, amazing product. Works really good on acne. Pair with other moisturizer and you are done. Tried different products to get rid of these stubborn acne but this is amazing and with retinoid too. Benefits twice, leaves skin smooth.

Love it!!! A product that finally cleared my skin! Love that fragrance free and absolutely no rush on my skin after using. Works incredibly well Highly recommend to everyone who has a problem with skin. Its a really good addiction to your daily routine

First of all, I was rather surprised how small the product is compared to the packaging. I read retinoids are best implemented slowly into the skincare routine, so I currently use it 1 to 2 times a week. It's too early to see any real effects, but so far I also haven't had seen any negative effects on my skin.

Neutrogena Evenly Clear Facial Retinoid is a lightweight acne fighting formula, that goes on clear, and is fragrance-free. This formula absorbs quickly, leaves no residue on the face, and feels weightless when wearing. It works great to keep my complexion clear. I only wish the size of the tube was bigger, to contain more product. The product itself works very well.

I received this product for free in exchange for my honest review. This gel worked really well for my skin. It helped reduce my breakouts significantly in just 2 days! It didnt dry out or burn my skin like some acne treatments tend to do. I highly recommend if you're looking to reduce your breakouts and clear up your skin.
I used this product as soon as I got it. It made my facial skin feel soft and smooth. I can see the results on my skin after one use. It blends into my skin perfectly.
It is what I hoped it would be. Good consistency, didn't dry up my skin, and spread easily. Only took off a star because of how small the bottle is. Other than that, it's a good product.

I waited to apply this product when I got a few pimples on my face. I immediately applied it before applying my moisturizer on top. My pimples went away the next morning! I was so surprised. At first I was worried that it would dry out my face because I've heard that retinoids can cause dryness. It felt a little tight in the areas that I applied, but it wasn't too terrible since I put my moisturizer on afterwards. I will definitely continue to use this product in the future! I've never found something that cures my pimples so quickly until now.

avis.titre: My skin had to adjust, but it WAS worth
avis.texte: I don't wear much makeup so I've learned to embrace my natural skin. With Evenly Clear Facial Retinoid, I did have some peeling and slight redness at first, but my skin did adjust. Now it looks smoother, more even and brighter overall. Fine lines have softened, and my skin just feels and looks healthier. Evenly Clear Facial Retinoid is now part of my nighttime routine.

Neutrogena Evenly Clear Retinoid This product clears acne and visibly fades acne marks over time. This product is a dermatologist recommended retinoid. It helps prevent acne breakouts. I use it daily. It helps keep pores clean. It clears skin in two weeks. I love that this is fragrance free. It absorbs quickly and can be worn under makeup. I applied this to clean skin. This product helps clear acne. It has a nice texture and doesn't burn my skin. This is a great product for adults. I recommend this for treatment of acne. Neutrogena has great products. I highly recommend this Neutrogena product. It feels amazing on my skin. It reduces acne bumps. This product is easy to apply. This is the product to use of you have acne. It can be used under makeup.
I didn't notice any difference since using this product. It also has a lot of warnings which led me to give this the side eye

I tried this once so far, and it works great! I'm pretty sure it made my pimples smaller. It's also great for sensitive skin, it didn't irritate my skin at all and I have sensitive skin. I would definitely buy this again.

The Evenly Clear Facial Retinoid left my skin feeling refreshed! I used for 8 straight days and have seen an improvement on acne, and dark spots. My skin feels hydrated. Looking forward to seeing more results as I use this longer!
I have dry skin that really needs hydration. I was worried this retinoid would make my skin more dry and sensitive but it did not! This has really smoothed my skin and helped with acne!

I decided to try this retinoid cream when I had a small breakout. I followed the directions and applied it once a day. I did experience some mild tingling at first, but there was no redness or irritation. My breakout cleared up much faster than it normally would and the area looked noticeably clearer afterward. Usually it takes a long time for my skin to fully calm down in those spots, but this really sped up the process. Very impressed with the results.

I received Evenly clear as a free sample to test. Evenly Clear Facial retinoid cream was a really good product that worked great for acne treatment. I have sensitive skin and I did not have any adverse reactions while using it. My skin definitely felt clearer when using this product. I would recommend!

I absolutely loved this product. It was so light on application I kept second guessing myself if I had put any on. This really softened the surface of my skin, and my skin feels like it has more elasticity and also more plump. I love how this really worked for me. My skin type is combination with no sensitivities or allergies of any kind. I highly recommend giving this a try if you feel like what you're using is failing you. This will not. Hope this helps any girly looking for something that works and has the same skin background I do.

avis.titre: Gentle enough for my sensitive skin
avis.texte: I have been on a journey on finding retinoids that would work on my sensitive and combination skin. Most of the adapalene brands have caused stinging and burning feeling but this one worked very well with my skin and it didn't cause redness or irritation. I'm already planning on buying a refill soon.

I've been using the Evenly Clear Facial Retinoid for several weeks now, and I'm genuinely impressed with the results. I was a little nervous at first because retinoids can sometimes irritate my skin, but this formula has been surprisingly gentle while still being active. The texture is lightweight and absorbs quickly without feeling greasy or heavy. After about two weeks, I started noticing a smoother texture and a more even skin tone. Some dark spots have visibly faded, and my skin looks brighter and clear overal.
First impressions… it went on and didn't feel too heavy or sticky. It absorbed quickly and didn't break my face out like some retinoids do.

This cream came at the right time. It was that time of the month and I always get a blemish or two before. And this helped me reduce the size and it was gone within a few days. I am so glad I found it. I am using retinoids now and it is a great all in one product.

Neutrogena's new 0.01% Adepalene gel is fantastic. I like using. Adepalene over Rx retinol. This gel cream absorbs fast and leaves no residue. Go slow at first to build your tolerance. I have dry skin and I use this to refine my texture and give me that glass skin glow. I love you couldn't find it anywhere..

I have been using neutrogena Evenly Clear retinoid and so far I'm happy with the results. The texture is light weight and absorbs quickly. I like that it's fragrance free. I started slowly every other day I was afraid it would irritate my skin but it didn't. Now I use it every evening and I can see the results. It does cause a little dryness at first but my moisturizer took care of it. My breakouts are less frequent and my skin looks more even. Great affordable retinoid product.

I started using Evenly Clear Facial Retinoid hoping to improve my skin texture and reduce breakouts, and I've pleasantly surprised by the results. At first, I was a little worried about irritation, but when I used a small amount and followed up with moisturizer, my skin adjusted well. Over time, I noticed my skin looked smoother and more even, especially in areas when I had stubborn dark spots. What I like most is that it feels lightweight and absorbs quickly without leaving my skin greasy. After a few weeks of consistent use, I saw fewer breakouts and a brighter overall complexion. I also appreciate that it works gradually without causing excessive dryness when I use it properly.

I've been using this Adapalene gel as part of my favorite acne routine from neutrogena, and it had made such a difference in my skin dealing with hormonal breakouts. The evenly clear line in general works wonders for my skin and this treatment specifically helped calm my acne flare-ups and prevent new pimples from forming. It's a lightweight gel, absorbs quick with no residue. Definitely a staple in my routine!

Im so happy Neutrogena made this line evenly clear. It the best products for acne on your face. I always been a fan of Neutrogena products and was excited to try this out. It the acne treatment for your face. I do get ance in my 40's now and so frustrating. But this product does help with that. I have seen a big change in my face acne. The texture is very lightweight and creamy. It blends very nicely and so gentle on your skin. I didn't get no irritation at all or redness on my face.

avis.titre: Want a face clear? Wait for it....
avis.texte: I got Evenly Clear Facial Retinoid for free from Home Tester Club, and I would have to say that after using this ointment, my acne did get worse; however, as it said on the box, I need at least a week for my skin to get used to it and improve, but by HTC, I was instructed for 1-2 days to test it then review. I believe that this product could have great potential, but it says that I need to use it for at least 3 months to see results. I do not think that I want to keep using a product that makes it worse and then fixes it after that long. Also, another thing is that all of the warnings on the box made me very nervous to even start this product, thinking that my face was going to fall off once I started it.

Small, but might product! This came just in time, I had a huge forehead pimple above eyebrow and a few on my forehead. I had applied the product to the areas at night time and I could definitely see that it helped clear the area within two days. It's a smooth, non irritating formula and you truly only need a little amount. A little goes a long way!

Easy to use and did help clear up my face. However, I personally did not really care for the scent of it but that is a personal preference. It is not an overly strong scent but I just did noy care for it. The product overall works good and did help to clear up my face.
I found this product to really smooth out my skin, especially my chin which is my problem area. It worked almost immediately to calm down any blemishes.
The Retinoid is very absorbent. Its a very silky soft texture goes on the skin super smooth. I get small break outs and definetly reduces the break out gradually.

I've been using Neutrogena Evenly Clear Facial Retinoid for a couple weeks now, and I am pretty impressed with the results. The texture is lightweight and absorbs quickly without leaving a greasy or sticky feeling, which makes it easy to layer under a moisturizer. What I love most is how gentle it feels compared to other retinoids I've tied. I had minimal irritation and no severe dryness, as long as I followed up with a good moisturizer. Within a couple weeks, my skin tine started looking more even. My overall complexion also looks smoother and brighter. It's a great option if you are new to retinoids or want something effective but not overly harsh. Just remember to apply it at night and wear sunscreen during the day, since retinoids can make your skin more sensitive to the sun. I would definitely recommend it to anyone looking to improve uneven skin tone and texture without overwhelming their skin.

My skin wasnt doing the best when I had received this product and then after using for a couple weeks now, im seeing a difference in the clarity of my skin. It does dry out my skin a little bit but I just make sure to stay extra moisturized. Good product!
This product goes on super smooth, not irritating at all or sticky. Worked like a charm clearing up my acne spots after just using it twice!

I really like this product. I use it in combination with my other skincare products, and it works well with them. It doesn't dry, or irritate my skin, and it helps any pimples I have go away. I highly recommend this product.
I didn't see much of any improvement in my skin after using it regularly. It's not going to be added to my skincare routine after it runs out.

I used this product for over a week and can tell it has helped me reduce my acne to about 80 percent. It's easy to apply. I wish the product was a combination of retinoid and moisturizer since I feel my skin getting dry after usage. Would definitely recommend it for spot treatment.

Neutrogena Evenly Clear works really well, I followed the directions on the box. I used it and cleared up my blemishes. My teenage son has a lot of acne and I used this on him for over a week and I'm impressed with the results. It really works. He's going to keep using it. I do wish the tube was bigger. He said even his friends asked him what he's been doing differently that his acne is clearing up.

I've been dealing with hormonal acne and nothing I've tried seems to make a real difference. I was a bit skeptical at first because the bottle claims your acne may get worse before it gets better but that wasn't the case for me. The only side effect I've noticed so far is drier skin which can be easily fixed with a good moisturizer or possibly using it less than daily. I've only been using the retinoid for about 10 days but in that time I've had no new breakouts and my existing acne has reduced in size and redness. I haven't seen any effects on older acne scars or discoloration yet. Overall I think this is a great option for people struggling to eliminate acne with general skincare. It is actually a clinically proven formula which is nice to get at an affordable price without an expensive doctor's visit

I found that this retinoid seemed to help heal the pimples on my chin a little more quickly than usual. It's best to use it sparingly, as it's a bit drying on the skin. I used it for just small spots.

Overall, my opinion of the product is positive yet I don't have acne on my face right now. I appreciate that the product is lightweight and gentle on my sensitive skin. I like the texture of the product too as it absorbs quickly into my skin and the fact that it is fragrance free.
This daily retinoid did control acne however it did dry out my face. I had to use a heavy moisturizer to balance the dryness. Doesn't really have a smell which is a good thing.

In the two weeks that I have used this produced I have noticed clearer skin and a more even skin tone. Breakouts are slowing and I am excited to continue use of this product to see the full potential.

Evenly Clear Facial Retinoid is a great way to reduce to look of redness from breakouts. This formula is silky and applies easily. I had a breakout on my cheek and after 1 use, the redness of the breakout was almost non-existent. I would recommend this product to others.

Neutrogena Evenly Clear Retinoid Gel is a powerful acne treatment that contains 0.1% adapalene. It claims to treats and prevents acne, fades acne marks, and improves skin tone and texture in just 8 weeks. I've tried it, and while it works, I've found that there are better products out there - but they come with a hefty price tag. This one is affordable and does the job, just a bit slower than the others. One tip: it works faster if you don't wear makeup. This product is fragrance-free and oil-free gel layers well under makeup and is suitable for once a day use. Overall, I like it and would recommend for the price. 5 uses later. My skin was clearer and I only have 1 visible acne mark. The tiny container is deceiving but a little goes a long way! Highly recommend it. Can u add a little humor but still say the same?

I was so thankful to learn that you could get such an amazing product without the need for a prescription! I've struggled with acne all of my life and this product has truly helped not only clear my acne, but it's lessened the appearance of previous acne "scarring" that I've had for awhile as well! The tube looks rather small but it only takes the smallest amount to thinly layer over your skin (right after cleansing) so a little goes such a long way! You only need to use it once a day and I saw slight results only within several days of using but within as little as three months you should see even the bigger benefit! My teens love this as well and it will definitely stay a part of our everyday skincare routine! I've always trusted, and loved, the Neutrogena brand and this product does not disappoint!
This is a great product. I love that. It's a once a day topical retinoid. It moisturize as well and I know it's providing me. Excellent benefits as well. I'm excited to continue using it.
I don't notice much of a difference. I did like the texture and how it made my skin feel but don't see any difference in the actual evenness of my skin.

So I decided to swap out my usual retinol product with the Neutrogena Evenly Clear and so far so good. I was hoping my skin didn't react negatively to it and it didn't. It glides on well and feels good on my skin. Not enough time to test to see real results, but I'll keep using it and see what happens.

It's way too early to see real results, but it doesn calm my acne down, and it's not too harsh on my skin compared to other brands I've tried. Also, a lot easier to spread around my face than other retinol products I've tried.
Works good for acne! At first I thought it was worsening my acne, but after a while it started clearing up! Although I would still prefer my main brand over this, this is a decent alternative.

I'm happy with the results. The formula feels lightweight and silky, not greasy or heavy, and it absorbs quickly. It's surprisingly gentle for a retinoid. I experienced minimal dryness. I've noticed a visible reduction in uneven areas.

I love this product. I have mild acne on my forehead and around my cheeks. I have used this product daily and it has reduced my acne by so much. It did not dry my face at all. I recommend it to anyone who needs to reduce acne. It also help fade acne marks from the past.
It's great for acne prone skin. Retinol product tends to be sensitive for skin but this didn't give me any sensitivity. I feel my skin became smooth and soft after using this for two weeks.

In Exchange, for my honest review I received this product thanks to the @HometesterClub and, @Neutrogena . Neutrogena Clear retinoid acne treatment cream is a great product. I wanted to leave a review after using it for a few weeks. My skin has become clearer, smoother, and all around looks awesome. Honestly, this cream is identical to using the prescription to RETIN-A. I highly recommend and I love Neutrogena products. I can always count on Neutrogena to get the job done..

Fantastic results using this retinoid. Does not clog pores as it helps our skin to rejuvenate. Does not cause skin rashes or leave a greasy feeling. Does not leave a white residue. SERUM Cream vanishes into the skin. ONCE A DAY TREATMENT.

The texture of this is great, it is light and smooth on the skin and sits well under moisturizer. I have gotten mild irritation from prescription strength retinoid before but did not have that with this product. I used it both on my face and neck. Some of my acne spots do appear lighter which is a big plus for me. This is a very good drugstore option if you are looking for something affordable and non-irritating.
The first night I used this I woke up the next morning with my pimples noticeably shrunk. It's light on the face not heavy at all. No scent. Not sticky at all.

A little goes a long way with this retinoid. A dab on my forehead, nose, and chin before rubbing into my face and done. It absorbs easily with no pilling. I have been using it every night before bed and have already noticed a difference only a couple of weeks in. My facial skin texture is moving more towards smooth and less visible pores. My trouble spots have not popped up any more pimples and the evenness is coming back to my face.

I get breakouts occasionally and am curious about retinoids to treat them. My skin was fairly clear when I started this treatment and broke out a little after I started using it. After use, my skin was dry so moisturizer is a must with this treatment. I haven't noticed a huge difference in skin quality after use, but I think I may just need to use it for longer to see results.
cleared up my mild acne within a weeks time with daily use. has prevented breakouts since beginning use. I haven't noticed much difference in the appearance of past scars and marks so far.

I love this product! I am 35 and still have breakouts (mostly in my chin) that drive me crazy. I have been using this for the last few months and my skin is looking better than ever. I did have some extra dryness at first but that didn't last long once my skin got used to it .

I tried this for about a week and a half so far so good. I love the glow that it gives the Neutrogena evenly clear retinoid is a gel with 0.1% acne treatment once daily topical retinoid. It has a silky filling, nice and cool to the touch which I really like. It is dermatologist recommended we'll definitely buy again.

My overall opinion is positive so far with this product. I feel like some times it can be difficult to properly guage the benefits and outcome of a product correctly when you're given a quick window to review an item. Often times, you most likely don't have enough time to fully see the results. With that being said, I appreciate that its suitable for daily use on several skin types, and absorbs quickly. I also like that its lightweight, oil-free, and fragrance free. Hidden synthetic fragrances are more often than not, irritants.
I've noticed a big improvement in my skin once I started using Evenly Clear by Neutrogena. It's kept my skin clear on acne. I recommend it.

This acne care is meant for long-term skin care, as opposed to simply fixing appearance overnight. It's easy to spread all over whatever area you need cleared up and has no unpleasant scent. The small tube size makes this great for both storing easily as well as taking anywhere you might need it to go.

I have been using Evenly Clear for a couple weeks and am satisfied! I use a pea size amount every evening after moisturizing, then apply moisturizer again (on top of this gel). I have very sensitive skin and have not had any issues with this product drying out my face, causing redness or irritation. I haven't expected any changes in my skin since it takes 8-12 weeks for noticeable results, but I do think my skin looks clearer than before.

I love this neutrogena retinoid for all my stubborn blemishes. I think that my face looks visibly better with combating my clogged bumps and also with my previous blemish scars. I also use this on my boyfriend as he's currently struggling with his acne and he's also very happy with his results as well. As a couple, we incorporate this into our skincare routine.

Overall I liked the product, as someone who has used a prescription retinol it is lovely to be able to get one over the counter and this product did not dry out my skin at all either! My two complaints are the product size is very small and the size of the box is just wasteful because of that fact.

I do like the consistency of this product. It glides on the skin nicely and absorbs quickly. I have sensitive skin and I didn't notice any irritation which was great. I personally didn't notice too much of a difference but I've only been using it for a little over two weeks so I imagine that I will start to see improvement as I continue to use it. Also the product comes out fast so I learned real quick that you should be careful when squeezing project out. Also it isn't that much product, it is a small tube, which is a bit of a downside.

I wanted to love this product because I love Neutrogena in general. However, after a couple of nights of use, my skin was basically sunburned without any sun. It turned red and peeled and was on FIRE! I never have any reactions so I was really surprised this bothered me so badly.
a little goes a long way. goes on smoothly and is clear, doesn't leave any white streaks. minimized my pimples after a few days of use

I've been using this Neutrogena Evenly Clear Retinoid Acne Treatment for a little while now and I'm really impressed. My breakouts have started clearing up and my skin looks smoother overall. It's lightweight, absorbs quickly, and doesn't feel greasy or heavy on my face. I also like that it helps with dark marks.
Didn't hurt sensitive skin to apply, which can be a problem. It applied easily and absorbed well. Skin did not feel irritated afterwards. Nice texture as well.

Neutrogena Evenly Clear Adapalene Gel 0.1% has been tough on stress acne! I apply a small drop at night after cleansing and air drying my face. There is no scent and no extra irritation. I like that its a clear gel because sometimes I don't rub it in completely but I don't get residue either. My acne is gone in 48 hours. I definitely recommend it for stubborn acne!

Evenly Clear Facial Retinoid is tiny in size looks like a free sample. For this size it must work miracles. Well let me tell you I used it daily and in 3 days I saw a difference in the appearance of the acne and within a week I noticed that the scars were less apparent. It works and I'm happy with the formula.

This evenly clear retinoid treatment worked great to help reduce my acne. I used it once a day after cleaning my face and then moisturized after it. It's easy to use and apply. Its a new part of my everyday routine and my face has never looked better.

The Neutrogena Evenly Clear Facial Retinoid has been a great addition to my skincare routine when I have a blemish. The texture is lightweight and absorbs quickly without feeling greasy or heavy on the skin. It felt gentle for a retinoid product. I didn't experience any irritation or dryness. Overall, this is a solid OTC option for anyone looking to introduce a retinoid into their routine to help improve skin texture and promote a more even-looking complexion. I received this product for free from HomeTester Club for testing and review purposes.

Neutrogena evenly clear retinoid was easy to apply and not greasy but it did burn with first use. I think that's normal for a retinoid though. I would recommend using a moisturizer before application and after. I think this is a good product for acne, just may be a little harsh at first until skin gets used to it.
